**DK25.2** is a medical diagnosis code representing acute gastric ulcer with hemorrhage and perforation ("akut mavesår med blødning og perforation") [^src1]. It is utilized within the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality databases, specifically functioning as a key component in the indicator that measures the incidence of severe bleeding among patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1]. 

As part of the broader methodology for measuring clinical quality in cardiovascular care, DK25.2 is one of many codes used to track gastrointestinal bleeding. The full range of codes for gastrointestinal bleeding in this indicator includes [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] through [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through [[dk92-2|DK92.2]] [^src1]. 

The severe bleeding indicator relies on a comprehensive set of diagnoses to capture all relevant adverse events. In addition to gastrointestinal issues, the methodology tracks intracranial hemorrhages using codes such as [[di60|DI60]], [[di61|DI61]], [[di62|DI62]], [[ds064|DS064]], [[ds065|DS065]], and [[ds066|DS066]] [^src1]. It also monitors urinary and respiratory tract bleeding through codes including [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]] [^src1]. The definitions and technical methodologies for these codes are documented in the annual reports for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP) [^src1] [^src2].
